title: Treewidth order conjecture for token graphs of trees
statement:
Let $G$) be a tree on $n$ vertices, and let $F_k(G)$ denote its $k$-token graph, whose vertices are the $k$-subsets of $V(G)$. For a fixed integer $k$ satisfying $1\le k\le n-1$, **the treewidth order conjecture for token graphs of trees.**

$$
\operatorname{tw}(F_k(G)) \in \Theta(n^{k-1}).
$$

This extends the established order of growth for token graphs of stars and paths to all trees. The conjecture is presented as open in the source.
source_name: Ruy Fabila-Monroy, Sergio Gerardo Gómez-Galicia, César Hernández-Cruz and Ana Laura Trujillo-Negrete, “On the Treewidth of Token and Johnson Graphs”, arXiv:2402.17962 (2025).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.17962

Status: **solved** according to the source (as of February 2024). “This conjecture was proved by Caputo, Liggett and Richthammer .”
